screen.delvefold.setup.terrain.help: Terrain is the permanent foundation of this mining world. You can change it later only through a confirmed recreation.
screen.delvefold.setup.terrain.detail.fl: Flat — layered, predictable geology for efficient branch mining and automation.
screen.delvefold.setup.terrain.detail.ca: Cavern — compact connected caves carved inside continuous stone.
screen.delvefold.setup.terrain.detail.wi: Wild — hills, valleys, caves, and an Overworld-like exploration experience.
screen.delvefold.setup.terrain.scale.exp: Expansive adds depth; only Wild uses amplified terrain.
screen.delvefold.setup.terrain.geology_t: Classic preserves Delvefold's established stone composition without themed strata or decorations.
Volcanic adds bounded tuff, basalt, blackstone, magma, sealed lava, ash, and subterranean rumbling.
Dripstone adds bounded dripstone, calcite, tuff, sealed water, dripping particles, and cave resonance.
Lush adds bounded clay, mud, rooted dirt, moss, sealed water, spores, and leafy ambience.
Crystal adds bounded calcite, smooth basalt, amethyst, sealed water, glimmers, and crystalline chimes.
screen.delvefold.setup.terrain.seed_mode: Stable repeats ore, province, geology, and landmark layouts when this world is recreated.
Rotate on recreation gives ores, provinces, geology, and landmarks a new deterministic layout.
